faq.a1: No. The program starts from absolute zero. If you already have a level, the initial test will place you at the exact point in the curriculum.
faq.a2: It is adaptive: it starts with easy questions and adjusts difficulty based on your answers. When you finish you receive your estimated level, your strengths and weaknesses, and a recommended curriculum.
faq.a3: A method based on the forgetting curve: every word or character reappears right before you forget it. The system recalculates intervals with each review based on how well you remember each item.
faq.a4: Yes. The program is aligned with your chosen language's official exams and includes mock exams, vocabulary and grammar tests, and a dedicated exam trainer.
faq.a5: With Tian Zi Ge grids, stroke-order animations, and practice with mouse, trackpad, or touchscreen. Each character includes its radical, components, and related words.
faq.a6: Yes: the application is fully responsive and can be installed as an app (PWA) with basic offline functionality.
faq.a7: You decide the intensity: from 15 minutes a day to an intensive exam plan. The planner adjusts sessions to your real availability and recovers missed days.
